say:1:1060900201:0.text: Welcome to Keith's Treasure Hut, the home of priceless treasures and rare commodities from every corner of the world!
say:1:1060900201:0.source_cn: 欢迎来到基斯的奇珍屋！这里汇聚了世界各地的珍奇宝物和独...

say:2:1060900202:1.text: We strive to deliver special goods and gifts never to be found anywhere else.
say:2:1060900202:1.source_cn: 奇珍屋致力于为您带来无法在其他地方找到的独特商品和礼品。

say:3:1060900203:1.text: Discover your most cherished treasures right here and make memories that'll warm your hearts for a lifetime.
say:3:1060900203:1.source_cn: 希望您在这里找到心仪的宝物，并留下美好的回忆。
